comparison.objective: Fit elbows to copper and plastic pipes, first inserting a support insert into the plastic pipe.
comparison.physical_skill: Material-dependent sequencing and three aligned push-fit insertions.
comparison.success_condition: Both elbows seated correctly; plastic joint requires prior insert and copper joint must not contain one.
comparison.reason: Tests rule-governed axial assembly and irreversible ordering, not adjustable damping, locking torque, or repeated impact-cycle convergence.
